name: Siluety
source:
A story about a girl who dreams of silhouettes of missing children and also sees how teenagers suffer in the real world. The girl lives in a small village where disappearances of children and teenagers often occur. She can't understand why she has these nightmares and what they mean.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2811110/]Steam[/url]]
